situation: The project holds 9 items. The repository has 13 open issues: 4 were never `gh project item-add`ed, so the project-items query cannot see them at all.
expected_guard: the three sections render from the 9 cards on the project; one line reports that 4 open issues are not on the board and names `phil:issue-board` as what adds them
must_not: render the 4 off-board issues as cards, which would report a board position they do not have
omit them silently, which is a completeness claim over issues the query never returned
describe the board as clear or complete while they are outstanding
count them in any section total
why_this_fixture_exists: A `projectV2` items query returns only what was added to the project, and this very repo's board is not linked to its repository — a card reaches it only by an explicit add. Without the reconciliation call, a read whose stated purpose is saying what is there omits four open issues in silence, which is the completeness failure the skill's own `Partial reads` rule forbids, arriving structurally rather than through a dropped page.
